stem: Which statement best describes how caries-risk assessment forms are structured?

options.text: They are divided by age group, use three factor categories, and produce a high, moderate, or low risk score.
One form is used for all ages, with three factor categories.
They are divided by age group but produce only a high or low result.
They are divided by age group and draw on a single factor category to give a high, moderate, or low score.
